About the School

A school built on care, curiosity, and character.

At Bukana Brilliant Schools, we believe education is about more than grades. It's about helping children develop confidence, compassion, and a genuine love of learning that stays with them for life.

Our teachers know every pupil by name and work closely with families to support each child's unique strengths, interests, and goals.

  • Small class sizes for individual attention
  • Dedicated, experienced teaching staff
  • Whole-child approach to development
  • Strong home-school partnership

Our Values

Excellence

Integrity

Respect

School Life

A well-rounded experience every day.

School life at Bukana is vibrant and varied. Students enjoy meaningful learning experiences, extracurricular activities, and a strong sense of belonging.

From classroom discoveries to community events, every day offers opportunities to grow, connect, and have fun.

Admissions

Begin the Journey

We welcome enquiries from families who share our commitment to education and character. The admission process is straightforward and supportive.

  1. Enquiry

    Get in touch to ask questions and book a school visit.

  2. School Visit

    Experience the school firsthand with a guided tour and assessment where applicable.

  3. Admission Decision

    Receive a thoughtful decision based on your child's needs and our capacity.

  4. Enrolment

    Complete enrolment and join our welcoming school community.
